title: Cooper's UFO in orbit

tellings.quote: uh just that it had come uh in proximity with him and I think he said it was green if I'm not mistaken

plain: The astronaut Gordon Cooper is said to have had an unknown object come close to his spacecraft while he was in orbit in 1963, and it was green, as far as the teller remembers. Charlie Foltz, a man who says he was himself abducted by aliens, tells Michels this as what Cooper told him, hedging with "if I'm not mistaken" about the color.
